title: Catalytic isomerization of branched allylic alcohols by water-soluble [RuCp(OH2)(PTA)2](CF3SO3) and [RuCp(OH2)(mPTA)2](CF3SO3)3
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29023-29033
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03564C, Paper
Open Access

Belén López-Sánchez, Franco Scalambra, Judit Cano-Asensio, Antonio Romerosa
The [RuCp(OH2)(PTA)2](CF3SO3) and [RuCp(OH2)(mPTA)2](CF3SO3)3 complexes were assessed for the isomerization of substituted allylic alcohols in water and aqueous media under mild conditions.
